, viewing the featured section.]] The In-Game Shop (or just Shop) is an extension of the Battle.net Shop and is used to purchase items and services from within the game itself. The store initially was only used in Asian regions at the outset, but has shipped worldwide in patch 5.4.2. The parental controls by default disable the In-Game Store. Accessing and configuring the settings of the parental controls will allow the store be available once again. This page lists the items that are mostly exclusive to the In-Game Shop and cannot be purchased from the online store, Battle.net Shop. For items available through both stores, see Shop items. The UI received an overhaul in patch 11.2.5.

Incremental Progress is part of a series of Horrific Visions Revisited achievements tasked with completing at least two of the bonus objectives and the final boss in any vision. It unlocks TickTak, the first of three weaponsmiths south of the Coreway in Dornogal. Until the hotfix on 3 June, earning this achievement required completing exactly two bonus objectives and the boss. Earning the achievement additionally unlocks potions during visions that can be drunk for various effects.

Inferna the Bound is a molten giant located in Dragonbane Keep in the Waking Shores. It was bound to the fort by the djaradin there and attempted to kill its captors with molten rocks which did not faze the djaradin. Some of those molten rocks were then used by Grand Flame to bind a large lava elemental to their will who was more manageable though they hoped that with practice they would able to control the giant as well. Inferna was later defeated by the Obsidian Outcasts and their allies when Dragonbane Keep was besieged by them in order retake it from the djaradin.

Infinity Studio is a collectible manufacturer known for producing statues and busts inspired by popular gaming franchises. Among its licensed franchises are detailed representations of some iconic Warcraft characters, such as Sylvanas Windrunner.
The Influx is the entrance area found in the Manaforge Omega where the Plexus Sentinel can be fought. Energy is pumped from here to the Forge Core.

Infinite Research is a repeatable meta quest offered by Eternus at the Infinite Bazaar south of Dalaran. It presents a choice of up to four quests and automatically completes when one of the offered quests is completed. It has no rewards of its own. The Pile of Chronoqueries indicates if there are quests available. There are more than a hundred possible Infinite Research quests, with objectives ranging from gathering timewarped resources to killing elite enemies to completing raids. After receiving the "Principal Chronoquery Investigator" promotion, the quests will start rewarding a Stack of Chronoqueries that'll refresh the current set of quests being offered. With the final phase of Legion
Infinite Chaos unlocks access to the Heroic World Tier of Legion Remix. Players must first finish the introduction questline before Eternus will offer this quest.

Ingoo Ingoo was a chief of the Unga hozen sometime around 10,000 BDP. He once beat the Monkey King in a drinking contest and claimed the handle of the Harmonic Mallet as his prize, not knowing that the Monkey King had lost on purpose in order to provide the mallet a safe hiding place. The Monkey King considered Ingoo a great hozen with "nice parties" and "great booze". The handle remained in Ingoo's family on Unga Ingoo, passing from father to son, but his descendants forgot the mallet's purpose and used it to do harm. His last known descendant was Chief Ingoo Ingoo XVII.

Ingenious Identifier is a finishing crafting reagent that can increase Ingenuity while crafting items from Midnight professions that can be crafted with Concentration. It can be obtained by fulfilling Crafting Orders or by opening an Artisan's Consortium Payout. 5 of them can be combined to form a Ingenious Identity.

Ingenious Identity is a finishing crafting reagent that can increase Ingenuity by 25 while crafting items from Midnight professions that can be crafted with Concentration. An ink trader is an NPC who offers various inks in exchange for one specific ink. They may also sell other inscription supplies. Historically, their inventories were updated every expansion, changing what ink they accepted and adding inks from the previous expansion. The last ink trader update happened in . In retail, ink traders accept Umbral Ink and offer inks up through . In Classic, they accept Ink of the Sea (Wrath Classic), Blackfallow Ink (Cataclysm Classic), or Ink of Dreams (MoP Classic). Jessica Sellers is the only ink trader in Wrath Classic.

When they eventually sought the help of Tyrgon, it was too weak to eat and in critical condition, possessing the Sick and Suffering buff. Tyrgon was able to heal it with a Sunlight Flower balm and the Light, changing its name to a Healthy Proto-Whelpling with the Happy and Healthy buff.
